# Immutable pre-admission entrypoints

These complete public source bodies are copied from protected commit
`795d5d158b6a33d12ee77cd64fb761d6042c6b6a`. manifest.json records their
SHA256. They permit a genuine historical core195 setup and an independently
positioned neutralized-admission control in a disposable PostgreSQL fixture.
They are not production entrypoints and never execute against deployed data.
The helper verifies the digests, copies the complete canonical Alembic
environment under tmp_path, and preserves current canonical predecessor
migration bodies/module/roster locations. Historical compilation identity stays
outside current production src; it must not pollute current coverage.
